opportunities.title: Revolut Got Phished by an Email With 'gov.uk' in It. Your KYC Data Was the Collateral.
opportunities.why_now: A regulated fintech handling Bitcoin transaction data was fooled by a fake government domain, exposing passports and crypto activity for anyone who trusted the 'safe' custodian.
opportunities.angle: Incident postmortem — walk through the social engineering vector, then pivot to the standing thesis: centralized KYC databases are a standing liability, not a safety feature.

opportunities.title: Blockstream Says 'It Is Theft' and Refuses to Pay for Its Own Bitcoin Back — Here's Why That Matters More Than the $320M
opportunities.why_now: Blockstream is publicly refusing a ransom for ~600 BTC stolen from Liquid, setting a precedent test case for how federated sidechains handle extortion.
opportunities.angle: Explainer/analysis on ransom-refusal precedent — what happens to the BTC now, and what this means for the next protocol that gets hit.

opportunities.title: Anthropic Just Confirmed Claude Was Used to Run Cyberattacks. Your Threat Model Is Already Out of Date.
opportunities.why_now: Anthropic's own admission that Claude has been weaponized for surveillance and attacks is a watershed disclosure for AI-assisted crypto exploits.
opportunities.angle: Security-forward explainer on how LLM-assisted attacks change the exploit pipeline for wallets/exchanges — practical takeaways for operators, not AI-panic.

opportunities.title: SBF Asks the Supreme Court to Undo an $11B Forfeiture. Here's Why That Petition Is Going Nowhere.
opportunities.why_now: SBF's fresh Supreme Court petition is a live news hook, and 'already know how this ends' is the exact voice for previewing the inevitable denial.
opportunities.angle: Legal-explainer with a cynical, confident prediction — cite precedent on fraud forfeiture appeals, close with the actual odds.

opportunities.title: Bitcoin's Golden Cross Just Flickered Off Right as CryptoQuant Says $81,700 Is the Line — Coincidence?
opportunities.why_now: Two competing market-structure signals (golden cross fading, resistance level cited as bull-market confirmation) landed within a day of each other, right before a hot CPI print and rate-hike odds spiking to 64%.
opportunities.angle: Security-minded market skepticism piece — treat the bullish framing the way you'd treat an unaudited contract: show your work before you believe the number.
